verses.sloka: तयोस्तदा सादितयो रणाग्रे मुमोह सैन्यं हरिपुङ्गवानाम्।सुग्रीवनीलाङ्गदजाम्बवन्तो न चापि किञ्चित् प्रतिपेदिरे ते ।। ६.७४.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tayostadā sāditayo raṇāgre mumoha sainyaṁ haripuṅgavānām।sugrīvanīlāṅgadajāmbavanto na cāpi kiñcit pratipedire te ।। 6.74.1 ।।

translations.english: The two brothers (Rama and Lakshmana) become unconscious in the forefront of the battle the monkey leaders lose senses. Sugriva, Neela, Angada and Jambavantha did not know What to do.
translations.hindi: यद्ध कार्ड का उनहृत्तरवाँ छग पूरा हुआ । —— NRF 24 शि > ₹ अकळ. se सप्ततितमः सगः सहि नरान्तक हतं दृष्टा (चुक्रशुनेंऋतषभाः ¦ देवान्तकस्िमूधो च पौलस्त्यश्चर महोदरः

verses.sloka: ततो विषण्णं समवेक्ष्य सैन्यं विभीषणो बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठः।उवाच शाखामृगराजवीरानाश्वासयन्नप्रतिमैर्वचोभिः ।। ६.७४.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato viṣaṇṇaṁ samavekṣya sainyaṁ vibhīṣaṇo buddhimatāṁ variṣṭhaḥ।uvāca śākhāmṛgarājavīrānāśvāsayannapratimairvacobhiḥ ।। 6.74.2 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, foremost among the wise, Vibheeshana observing the despondency of the monkey leaders spoke to them reassuring in incomparable words.
translations.hindi: मेघ के समान एक बड़े ऊँचे हाथी पर चढ़ा हुआ वीर्यवान्‌ सहोदर, महापराक्रमी अङ्गद पर दौड़ा

verses.sloka: मा भैष्ट नास्त्यत्र विषादकालो यदार्यपुत्रौ ह्यवशौ विषण्णौ।स्वयम्भुवो वाक्यमथोद्वहन्तौ यत् सादिताविन्द्रजिदस्त्रजालैः ।। ६.७४.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: mā bhaiṣṭa nāstyatra viṣādakālo yadāryaputrau hyavaśau viṣaṇṇau।svayambhuvo vākyamathodvahantau yat sāditāvindrajidastrajālaiḥ ।। 6.74.3 ।।

translations.english: "O Noble men! Do not fear. Rama and Lakshmana are afflicted by Indrajith's volley of arrows and have lost senses. They are despondent to honour the statement of the creator not otherwise."
translations.hindi: भाई के मर जाने के दुःख से दुःखी बलवान्‌ देवान्तक भी एक चमचमाता परिघ लिए हुए अङ्कद पर झपटा

verses.sloka: तस्मै तु दत्तं परमास्त्रमेतत् स्वयम्भुवा ब्राह्मममोघवेगम्।तन्मानयन्तौ युधि राजपुत्रौ निपातितौ को ऽत्र विषादकालः ।। ६.७४.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmai tu dattaṁ paramāstrametat svayambhuvā brāhmamamoghavegam।tanmānayantau yudhi rājaputrau nipātitau ko 'tra viṣādakālaḥ ।। 6.74.4 ।।

translations.english: To him (Indrajith), the creator has conferred this weapon of Brahma endowed with terrific speed. To respect the missile both the princes have fallen. Why do you grieve?
translations.hindi: उत्तम घोड़ों से युक्त सूय के समान चमचमाते रथ पर बैठे हुए, वीर त्रिशिरा ने भी अङ्गद के ऊपर आक्रमण किआ

verses.sloka: ब्राह्ममस्त्रं ततो धीमान् मानयित्वा तु मारुतिः।विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा हनुमांस्तमथाब्रवीत् ।। ६.७४.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: brāhmamastraṁ tato dhīmān mānayitvā tu mārutiḥ।vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hanumāṁstamathābravīt ।। 6.74.5 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, hearing Vibheeshana's words, wise Hanuman spoke this with respect to the missile of Brahma.

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्निहते सैन्ये वानराणां तरस्विनाम्।यो यो धारयते प्राणांस्तन्तमाश्वासयावहै ।। ६.७४.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnihate sainye vānarāṇāṁ tarasvinām।yo yo dhārayate prāṇāṁstantamāśvāsayāvahai ।। 6.74.6 ।।

translations.english: "Whoever is strong among Vanaras, have been struck and are alive breathing among the Vanaras. Let us restore their confidence."
translations.hindi: देव राज इन्द्र जैसे वज चलाते हैं, वेसे ही अङ्गद ने देवान्तक को लक्ष्य कर बढ़ी बड़ी डालियों से युक्त वृत उसके ऊपर फेंका

verses.sloka: तावुभौ युगपद्वीरौ हनुमद्राक्षसोत्तमौ।उल्काहस्तौ तदा रात्रौ रणशीर्षे विचेरतुः ।। ६.७४.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāvubhau yugapadvīrau hanumadrākṣasottamau।ulkāhastau tadā rātrau raṇaśīrṣe viceratuḥ ।। 6.74.7 ।।

translations.english: The two heroes, Hanuman and Vibheeshana, and the foremost of Rakshasas with torch in hand searched for the left over Vanaras in the battlefield.

verses.sloka: भिन्नलाङ्गूलहस्तोरुपादाङ्गुलिशिरोधरैः।स्रवद्भिः क्षतजं गात्रैः प्रस्रवद्भिस्ततस्ततः ।। ६.७४.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhinnalāṅgūlahastorupādāṅguliśirodharaiḥ।sravadbhiḥ kṣatajaṁ gātraiḥ prasravadbhistatastataḥ ।। 6.74.8 ।।

translations.english: Two of them saw the ground covered with Vanaras of mountainlike forms, who had fallen with tails cut off, some with broken thighs, broken legs and fingers, necks severed, letting off blood, discharging urine and glowing weapons lying on the ground.
translations.hindi: किन्तु त्रिशिरा ने विषधर सर्प के समान तेज़ बाणों से उस वृक्ष को काट गिराया । वक्ष को कटा हुआ देख, अङ्गद उछले ७ स ववष ततो वक्षाजशलांश्च कपिकुञ्जरः न तान्‌ प्रचिच्छेद संक्रद्धखिशिरा निशितः शर!

verses.sloka: पतितैः पर्वताकारैर्वानरैरभिसङ्कुलाम्।शस्त्रैश्च पतितैर्दीप्तैर्ददृशाते वसुन्धराम् ।। ६.७४.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: patitaiḥ parvatākārairvānarairabhisaṅkulām।śastraiśca patitairdīptairdadṛśāte vasundharām ।। 6.74.9 ।।

translations.english: Two of them saw the ground covered with Vanaras of mountainlike forms, who had fallen with tails cut off, some with broken thighs, broken legs and fingers, necks severed, letting off blood, discharging urine and glowing weapons lying on the ground.

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवमङ्गदं नीलं शरभं गन्धमादनम्।गवाक्षं च सुषेणं च वेगदर्शिनमाहुकम् ।। ६.७४.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvamaṅgadaṁ nīlaṁ śarabhaṁ gandhamādanam।gavākṣaṁ ca suṣeṇaṁ ca vegadarśinamāhukam ।। 6.74.10 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana and Hanuman saw in the battlefield Sugriva, Angada, Neela, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Gavaksha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Ahuka, Mainda, Nala, Jyothimukha, Dwivida and Panasa struck down.
translations.hindi: हाथा प वारस हो र भा अङ्गद पर दा उँ आर अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हो, अङ्गद की छाती मै बज के समान तोमर का प्रहार किला

verses.sloka: मैन्दं नलं ज्योतिमुखं द्विविदं पनसं तथा।एतांश्चान्यांस्ततो वीरौ ददृशाते हतान् रणे ।। ६.७४.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: maindaṁ nalaṁ jyotimukhaṁ dvividaṁ panasaṁ tathā।etāṁścānyāṁstato vīrau dadṛśāte hatān raṇe ।। 6.74.11 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana and Hanuman saw in the battlefield Sugriva, Angada, Neela, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Gavaksha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Ahuka, Mainda, Nala, Jyothimukha, Dwivida and Panasa struck down.
translations.hindi: ऋद्ध हो देवान्तक भी अङ्गद की ओर बड़े वेग से झपटा ओर की छाती में परिघ सार कर भागा

verses.sloka: सप्तषष्टिर्हताः कोट्यो वानराणां तरस्विनाम्।अह्नः पञ्चमशेषेणः वल्लभेन स्वयम्भुवः ।। ६.७४.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: saptaṣaṣṭirhatāḥ koṭyo vānarāṇāṁ tarasvinām।ahnaḥ pañcamaśeṣeṇaḥ vallabhena svayambhuvaḥ ।। 6.74.12 ।।

translations.english: By the creator's missile Indrajith struck down sixtyseven crores of strong Vanaras between the fifth and last part of the day.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि इन तीनों राक्षसश्रेष्ठों ले मिल कर, एक साथ आक्रमण कर अङ्गद ` पर प्रहार किये, तथापि महातेजस्वी एवं प्रतापी अङ्गद तिल भर भी व्यथित न हुए

verses.sloka: सागरौघनिभं भीमं दृष्ट्वा बाणार्दितं बलम्।मार्गते जाम्बवन्तं स हनुमान् सविभीषणः ।। ६.७४.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sāgaraughanibhaṁ bhīmaṁ dṛṣṭvā bāṇārditaṁ balam।mārgate jāmbavantaṁ sa hanumān savibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.74.13 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana and Hanuman seeing the ocean of Vanara army and the glowing arrows on them, looked for Jambavantha.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर परम दुजय वानरश्रष्ठ अङ्गद ने बड़ी फर्ती से उळलकर, उस सहागज के मस्तक पर एक लात जमाई, जिस र महोदर सवार था

verses.sloka: स्वभावजरया युक्तं वृद्धं शरशतैश्चितम्।प्रजापतिसुतं वीरं शाम्यन्तमिव पावकम् ।। ६.७४.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: svabhāvajarayā yuktaṁ vṛddhaṁ śaraśataiścitam।prajāpatisutaṁ vīraṁ śāmyantamiva pāvakam ।। 6.74.14 ।।

translations.english: Paulastya (Vibheeshana of Paulastya clan), seeing the son of Prajapathi (Jambavan), who by nature was wise and aged, afflicted by hundreds of arrows, like a cooling fire sacrifice, went close by and spoke these words.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा तमुपसङ्गम्य पौलस्त्यो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।कच्चिदार्य शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः प्राणा न ध्वंसितास्तव ।। ६.७४.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tamupasaṅgamya paulastyo vākyamabravīt।kaccidārya śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ prāṇā na dhvaṁsitāstava ।। 6.74.15 ।।

translations.english: "O Noble Jambavan! Indeed, your life has not been afflicted with these sharp arrows." Hearing this, Jambavan uttered these words with difficulty."

verses.sloka: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा जाम्बवानृक्षपुङ्गवः।कृच्छ्रादभ्युद्गिरन् वाक्यमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.७४.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā jāmbavānṛkṣapuṅgavaḥ।kṛcchrādabhyudgiran vākyamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.74.16 ।।

translations.english: "O Noble Jambavan! Indeed, your life has not been afflicted with these sharp arrows." Hearing this, Jambavan uttered these words with difficulty."
translations.hindi: उस प्रहार से दे वान्तक इवा के भकोरे हुए पेड को तरह हिल उठा । उसके शारीर के समस्त अङ्ग शिथिल पड़ गये | उसके मुख से लाख के रंग जैसा बहुत सा रुधिर निकल गया

verses.sloka: नैर्ऋतेन्द्र महावीर्य स्वरेण त्वा ऽभिलक्षये।पीड्यमानः शितैर्बाणैर्न त्वां पश्यामि चक्षुषा ।। ६.७४.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: nairṛtendra mahāvīrya svareṇa tvā 'bhilakṣaye।pīḍyamānaḥ śitairbāṇairna tvāṁ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā ।। 6.74.17 ।।

translations.english: "Great hero, Vibheeshana! I recognise you by your voice. Pierced with sharp arrows I am not able to see you."
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर महातेजस्वी वीर देघान्तक ने अति कष्ट से सचेत हो, भयङ्कर परिघ के प्रहार से अङ्गद को घायल किआ

verses.sloka: अञ्जना सुप्रजा येन मातरिश्वा च नैर्ऽत।हनुमान् वानरश्रेष्ठः प्राणान् धारयते क्वचित् ।। ६.७४.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: añjanā suprajā yena mātariśvā ca nair'ta।hanumān vānaraśreṣṭhaḥ prāṇān dhārayate kvacit ।। 6.74.18 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana (Rakshasa)! Indeed, Hanuman, the foremost of Vanaras, by whose birth, Anjana and Supraja are blessed as parents, are they alive?
translations.hindi: उस परिघ के प्रहार से बालितनय अङ्गद घुटओं के बल जमीन पर गिर पड़े ; किन्तु कुछ ही क्षणों बाद सावधान हो, के उठ बेठे

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा जाम्बवतो वाक्यमुवाचेदं विभीषणः।आर्यपुत्रावतिक्रम्य कस्मात् पृच्छसि मारुतिम् ।। ६.७४.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā jāmbavato vākyamuvācedaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ।āryaputrāvatikramya kasmāt pṛcchasi mārutim ।। 6.74.19 ।।

translations.english: After hearing Jambavantha, Vibheeshana said "Noble son, why are you enquiring about Hanuman?"

verses.sloka: नैव राजनि सुग्रीवे नाङ्गदे नापि राघवे।आर्य सन्दर्शितः स्नेहो यथा वायुसुते परः ।। ६.७४.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: naiva rājani sugrīve nāṅgade nāpi rāghave।ārya sandarśitaḥ sneho yathā vāyusute paraḥ ।। 6.74.20 ।।

translations.english: "Noble one! You are showing affection to Hanuman but not to King Sugriva, or Angada or even Raghava?"
translations.hindi: इतने भें अङ्गद को तीन वीरश्रष्ठ राक्षसों द्वारा घेर कर मारे जाते देख, हनुमान और नील दोड़े

verses.sloka: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा जाम्बवान् वाक्यमब्रवीत्।शृणु नैर्ऋतशार्दूल यस्मात् पृच्छामि मारुतिम् ।। ६.७४.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā jāmbavān vākyamabravīt।śṛṇu nairṛtaśārdūla yasmāt pṛcchāmi mārutim ।। 6.74.21 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Vibheeshana, the tiger among Rakshasas, Jambavan replied, "Listen why I enquired about Maruthi."

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् जीवति वीरे तु हतमप्यहतं बलम्।हनुमत्युज्झितप्राणे जीवन्तो ऽपि वयं हताः ।। ६.७४.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin jīvati vīre tu hatamapyahataṁ balam।hanumatyujjhitaprāṇe jīvanto 'pi vayaṁ hatāḥ ।। 6.74.22 ।।

translations.english: If this hero Hanuman is alive, even if the army is destroyed and if we are alive, it is like dead only.

verses.sloka: धरते मारुतिस्तात मारुतप्रतिमो यदि।वैश्वानरसमो वीर्ये जीविताशा ततो भवेत् ।। ६.७४.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: dharate mārutistāta mārutapratimo yadi।vaiśvānarasamo vīrye jīvitāśā tato bhavet ।। 6.74.23 ।।

translations.english: "Dear! If Hanuman who is equal to wind god, resembles Vyshvanara (God of fire) is breathing, then we can hope to live (for life)."
translations.hindi: उस शौैलश्वङ्गघ को चूर चूर हो कर प्रथिवी पर गिरा हुआ देख, देवान्तक हर्षित हुआ और हाथ में परिघ ले वह लड़ने के लिए हनुमान्‌ के ऊपर झपटा

verses.sloka: ततो वृद्धमुपागम्य नियमेनाभ्यवादयत्।गृह्य जाम्बवतः पादौ हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।। ६.७४.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato vṛddhamupāgamya niyamenābhyavādayat।gṛhya jāmbavataḥ pādau hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।। 6.74.24 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Hanuman the son of the wind god coming close to the aged Jambavan clasped his feet in accordance with tradition and greeted him.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं तथापि व्यथितेन्द्रियः।पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्यते स्मर्क्षपुङ्गवः ।। ६.७४.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyaṁ tathāpi vyathitendriyaḥ।punarjātamivātmānaṁ manyate smarkṣapuṅgavaḥ ।। 6.74.25 ।।

translations.english: Then again, Jambavan whose senses were affected, on hearing the statement of Hanuman, the foremost of Vanaras, felt as though he was born again.

verses.sloka: ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमन्तं स जाम्बवान् ।। ६.७४.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato 'bravīnmahātejā hanumantaṁ sa jāmbavān ।। 6.74.26 ।।

translations.english: Then brilliant Jambavan spoke to Hanuman, the tiger among Vanaras, on reaching him. "You ought to protect the Vanaras."
translations.hindi: उस घूंसे की चोट से राक्षसराज रावण के पुत्र देवान्तक का मस्तक चूर चूर हो गया, दाँत और नेत्र निकल पड़े, जोभ लंबी हो कर मुख के बाहिर आ पड़ी । वह निर्जीव हो धड़ाम से भूमि पर गिर पड़ा

verses.sloka: आगच्छ हरिशार्दूल वानरांस्त्रातुमर्हसि।नान्यो विक्रमपर्याप्तस्त्वमेषां परमः सखा ।। ६.७४.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: āgaccha hariśārdūla vānarāṁstrātumarhasi।nānyo vikramaparyāptastvameṣāṁ paramaḥ sakhā ।। 6.74.27 ।।

translations.english: "You are fully endowed with prowess and great friend of monkeys in that way. It is time for you to show your talent. Indeed, I do not see anyone else."
translations.hindi: युद्ध में उस देवशत्र एवं महाबली मुख्य राक्षस योद्धा देवान्तक के मारे जाने पर, त्रिशिरा अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हुआ और उसने बड़े उग्र एवं पेने बाशों की, नील की छाती के ऊपर वर्षा की

verses.sloka: त्वत्पराक्रमकालो ऽयं नान्यं पश्यामि कञ्चन।ऋक्षवानरवीराणामनीकानि प्रहर्षय।विशल्यौ कुरु चाप्येतौ सादितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.७४.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvatparākramakālo 'yaṁ nānyaṁ paśyāmi kañcana।ṛkṣavānaravīrāṇāmanīkāni praharṣaya।viśalyau kuru cāpyetau sāditau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.74.28 ।।

translations.english: For the Bears and Vanaras, create excessive happiness. For Rama and Lakshmana who are unconscious, make them comfortable.

verses.sloka: गत्वा परममध्वानमुपर्युपरि सागरम्।हिमवन्तं नगश्रेष्ठं हनुमन् गन्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.७४.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: gatvā paramamadhvānamuparyupari sāgaram।himavantaṁ nagaśreṣṭhaṁ hanuman gantumarhasi ।। 6.74.29 ।।

translations.english: "Hanuman, you ought to go very far over the sea to the Himalayas, the highest mountain."

verses.sloka: ततः काञ्चनमत्युच्चमृषभं पर्वतोत्तमम्।कैलासशिखरं चापि द्रक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन ।। ६.७४.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāñcanamatyuccamṛṣabhaṁ parvatottamam।kailāsaśikharaṁ cāpi drakṣyasyariniṣūdana ।। 6.74.30 ।।

translations.english: "O Destroyer of enemies! there on top you will see the foremost of the mountain Rshaba and on the peak of Kailasa."

verses.sloka: तयोः शिखरयोर्मध्ये प्रदीप्तमतुलप्रभम्।सर्वौषधियुतं वीर द्रक्ष्यस्योषधिपर्वतम् ।। ६.७४.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ śikharayormadhye pradīptamatulaprabham।sarvauṣadhiyutaṁ vīra drakṣyasyoṣadhiparvatam ।। 6.74.31 ।।

translations.english: "Heroic Hanuman! In the middle of those two mountains, you will see a highly splendid mountain covered with all kinds of medicinal herbs."

verses.sloka: तस्य वानरशार्दूल चतस्रो मूर्ध्निसम्भवाः।द्रक्ष्यस्योषधयो दीप्ता दीपयन्त्यो दिशो दश ।। ६.७४.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya vānaraśārdūla catasro mūrdhnisambhavāḥ।drakṣyasyoṣadhayo dīptā dīpayantyo diśo daśa ।। 6.74.32 ।।

translations.english: "O Tiger among monkeys! You will see on the summit four medicinal herbs growing there illuminating the ten directions."

verses.sloka: मृतसञ्जीवनीं चैव विशल्यकरणीमपि।सावर्ण्यकरणीं चैव सन्धानकरणीं तथा ।। ६.७४.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: mṛtasañjīvanīṁ caiva viśalyakaraṇīmapi।sāvarṇyakaraṇīṁ caiva sandhānakaraṇīṁ tathā ।। 6.74.33 ।।

translations.english: "Mrtasanjivani, Visalyakarani, Suvarnakarani, Sandhani, all these herbs are grown there."

verses.sloka: ताः सर्वा हनुमन् गृह्य क्षिप्रमागन्तुमर्हसि।आश्वासय हरीन् प्राणैर्योज्य गन्धवहात्मज ।। ६.७४.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāḥ sarvā hanuman gṛhya kṣipramāgantumarhasi।āśvāsaya harīn prāṇairyojya gandhavahātmaja ।। 6.74.34 ।।

translations.english: "Hanuman, taking the four herbs you, the son of wind god ought to return immediately with the speed of wind, to unite the life of the monkeys and reassure."

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा जाम्बवतो वाक्यं हनुमान् हरिपुङ्गवः।आपूर्यत बलोद्धर्षैस्तोयवेगैरिवार्णवः ।। ६.७४.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā jāmbavato vākyaṁ hanumān haripuṅgavaḥ।āpūryata baloddharṣaistoyavegairivārṇavaḥ ।। 6.74.35 ।।

translations.english: "Hearing the instruction of Jambavantha, the son of the wind god, infused with wind speed as the ocean, heaves with the force of wind increasing his strength fully."

verses.sloka: स पर्वततटाग्रस्थः पीडयन् पर्वतोत्तमम्।हनुमान् दृश्यते वीरो द्वितीय इव पर्वतः ।। ६.७४.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa parvatataṭāgrasthaḥ pīḍayan parvatottamam।hanumān dṛśyate vīro dvitīya iva parvataḥ ।। 6.74.36 ।।

translations.english: Standing on the summit of the foremost of the mountains, hero Hanuman pressing his feet seemed like a second mountain

verses.sloka: हरिपादविनिर्भग्नो निषसाद स पर्वतः।न शशाक तदा ऽ ऽत्मानं सोढुं भृशनिपीडितः ।। ६.७४.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: haripādavinirbhagno niṣasāda sa parvataḥ।na śaśāka tadā ' 'tmānaṁ soḍhuṁ bhṛśanipīḍitaḥ ।। 6.74.37 ।।

translations.english: Trodden by the feet of Hanuman that mountain pressed forcibly by himself could not bear his strength.

verses.sloka: तस्य पेतुर्नगा भूमौ हरिवेगाच्च जज्वलुः।शृङ्गाणि च व्यशीर्यन्त पीडितस्य हनूमता ।। ६.७४.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya peturnagā bhūmau harivegācca jajvaluḥ।śṛṅgāṇi ca vyaśīryanta pīḍitasya hanūmatā ।। 6.74.38 ।।

translations.english: Oppressed by the speed of Hanuman, the mountain fell to the ground and by the impetuosity of his speed the mountain got shattered.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् सम्पीड्यमाने तु भग्नद्रुमाशिलातले।न शेकुर्वानराः स्थातुं घूर्णमाने नगोत्तमे ।। ६.७४.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin sampīḍyamāne tu bhagnadrumāśilātale।na śekurvānarāḥ sthātuṁ ghūrṇamāne nagottame ।। 6.74.39 ।।

translations.english: As the foremost of the mountain got oppressed it crushed the trees and rocks on it and Vanaras were unable to stand on it.

verses.sloka: सा घूर्णितमहाद्वारा प्रभग्नगृहगोपुरा।लङ्का त्रासाकुला रात्रौ प्रवृत्तेवाभवत्तदा ।। ६.७४.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: sā ghūrṇitamahādvārā prabhagnagṛhagopurā।laṅkā trāsākulā rātrau pravṛttevābhavattadā ।। 6.74.40 ।।

translations.english: Then the mighty gates of Lanka shaking, homes shattered, stricken with fear that night it seemed Lanka was dancing.

verses.sloka: पृथिवीधरसङ्काशो विपीड्य धरणीधरम्।पृथिवीं क्षोभयामास सार्णवां मारुतत्मजः ।। ६.७४.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīdharasaṅkāśo vipīḍya dharaṇīdharam।pṛthivīṁ kṣobhayāmāsa sārṇavāṁ mārutatmajaḥ ।। 6.74.41 ।।

translations.english: Son of the wind god, who was like a mountain supported by earth, pressing hard caused the earth with its ocean to shake.

verses.sloka: आरुरोह तदा तस्माद्धरिर्मलयपर्वतम्।मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशं नानाप्रस्रवणाकुलम् ।। ६.७४.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: āruroha tadā tasmāddharirmalayaparvatam।merumandarasaṅkāśaṁ nānāprasravaṇākulam ।। 6.74.42 ।।

translations.english: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.

verses.sloka: नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णं विकासिकमलोत्पलम्।सेवितं देवगन्धर्वैः षष्टियोजनमुच्छ्रितम् ।। ६.७४.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nānādrumalatākīrṇaṁ vikāsikamalotpalam।sevitaṁ devagandharvaiḥ ṣaṣṭiyojanamucchritam ।। 6.74.43 ।।

translations.english: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.

verses.sloka: विद्याधरैर्मुनिगणैरप्सरोभिर्निषेवितम्।नानामृगगणाकीर्णं बहुकन्दरशोभितम् ।। ६.७४.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vidyādharairmunigaṇairapsarobhirniṣevitam।nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṁ bahukandaraśobhitam ।। 6.74.44 ।।

translations.english: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.

verses.sloka: सर्वानाकुलयंस्तत्र यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरान्।हनुमान् मेघसङ्काशो ववृधे मारुतात्मजः ।। ६.७४.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvānākulayaṁstatra yakṣagandharvakinnarān।hanumān meghasaṅkāśo vavṛdhe mārutātmajaḥ ।। 6.74.45 ।।

translations.english: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.

verses.sloka: पद्भ्यां तु शैलमापीड्य वडवामुखवन्मुखम्।विवृत्योग्रं ननादोच्चैस्त्रासयन्निव राक्षसान् ।। ६.७४.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: padbhyāṁ tu śailamāpīḍya vaḍavāmukhavanmukham।vivṛtyograṁ nanādoccaistrāsayanniva rākṣasān ।। 6.74.46 ।।

translations.english: Pressing the mountain hard by his feet, opening his largemouth wide, he roared like Rakshasas to make Rakshasas fearful.

verses.sloka: तस्य नानद्यमानस्य श्रुत्वा निनदमद्भुतम्।लङ्कास्था राक्षसाः सर्वे न शेकुः स्पन्दितुं भयात् ।। ६.७४.४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya nānadyamānasya śrutvā ninadamadbhutam।laṅkāsthā rākṣasāḥ sarve na śekuḥ spandituṁ bhayāt ।। 6.74.47 ।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas in Lanka hearing the loud roar of Hanuman were afraid and could not stir from there.

verses.sloka: नमस्कृत्वा ऽथ रामाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः।राघवार्थे परं कर्म समीहतपरन्तपः ।। ६.७४.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtvā 'tha rāmāya mārutirbhīmavikramaḥ।rāghavārthe paraṁ karma samīhataparantapaḥ ।। 6.74.48 ।।

translations.english: Maruti, scorcher of enemies, endowed with terrific valour offered prayers to Sri Rama and made up his mind to embark on the stupendous task for Raghava.

verses.sloka: स पुच्छमुद्यम्य भुजङ्गकल्पं विनम्य पृष्ठं श्रवणे निकुञ्ज्य।विवृत्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभमापुप्लुवे व्योमनि चण्डवेगः ।। ६.७४.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa pucchamudyamya bhujaṅgakalpaṁ vinamya pṛṣṭhaṁ śravaṇe nikuñjya।vivṛtya vaktraṁ vaḍavāmukhābhamāpupluve vyomani caṇḍavegaḥ ।। 6.74.49 ।।

translations.english: Raising his tail which resembled a serpent, bending his back, and ears, opening his mouth wide expounded Hanuman sprang up at terrific speed.

verses.sloka: स वृक्षषण्डांस्तरसा जहार शैलान् शिलाः प्राकृतवानरांश्च।बाहूरुवेगोद्धतसम्प्रणुन्नास्ते क्षीणवेगाः सलिले निपेतुः ।। ६.७४.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vṛkṣaṣaṇḍāṁstarasā jahāra śailān śilāḥ prākṛtavānarāṁśca।bāhūruvegoddhatasampraṇunnāste kṣīṇavegāḥ salile nipetuḥ ।। 6.74.50 ।।

translations.english: By the speed of his arms and thighs clusters of branches of trees, mountains, rocks, and common monkeys were attracted, and with reduction of speed along the way the rocks fell.

verses.sloka: स
verses.transliteration: sa

translations.english: Stretching his arms which resembled coils of serpents, whose valour equalled Garuda, enemy of serpents, as if attracting all the directions went to the summit of the foremost mountain which equalled Meru mountain.

verses.sloka: तौ प्रसार्योरगभोगकल्पौ भूजौ भुजङ्गारिनिकाशवीर्यः।जगाम मेरुं नगराजमग्र्यं दिशः प्रकर्षन्निव वायुसूनुः ।। ६.७४.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau prasāryoragabhogakalpau bhūjau bhujaṅgārinikāśavīryaḥ।jagāma meruṁ nagarājamagryaṁ diśaḥ prakarṣanniva vāyusūnuḥ ।। 6.74.51 ।।

translations.english: Observing the ocean whose waves were made to revolve round (by his speed), exceedingly, whose creatures were made to whirl round violently (by the wind force generated by his speed), he went forth like the wheel loosened from Vishnu's hand.

verses.sloka: स सागरं घूर्णितवीचिमालं तदा भृशं भ्रामितसर्वसत्त्वम्।समीक्षमाणः सहसा जगाम चक्रं यथा विष्णुकराग्रमुक्तम् ।। ६.७४.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa sāgaraṁ ghūrṇitavīcimālaṁ tadā bhṛśaṁ bhrāmitasarvasattvam।samīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā jagāma cakraṁ yathā viṣṇukarāgramuktam ।। 6.74.52 ।।

translations.english: Watching the mountains, trees, birds, rivers, tanks, the best of cities, all of them and prosperous people, he went at his father's speed.

verses.sloka: स पर्वतान् वृक्षगणान् सरांसि नदीस्तटाकानि पुरोत्तमानि।स्फीतान् जनान्तानपि सम्प्रवीक्ष्य जगाम वेगात् पितृतुल्यवेगः ।। ६.७४.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa parvatān vṛkṣagaṇān sarāṁsi nadīstaṭākāni purottamāni।sphītān janāntānapi sampravīkṣya jagāma vegāt pitṛtulyavegaḥ ।। 6.74.53 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman who was equal to his father in prowess, went unwearied, hurriedly in the path of the Sun.

verses.sloka: आदित्यपथमाश्रित्य जगाम स गतक्लमः।हनुमांस्त्वरितो वीरः पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः ।। ६.७४.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ādityapathamāśritya jagāma sa gataklamaḥ।hanumāṁstvarito vīraḥ pitṛtulyaparākramaḥ ।। 6.74.54 ।।

translations.english: Maruthi, the tiger among monkeys went like the wind possessing great speed filling sound in all directions.

verses.sloka: जवेन महता युक्तो मारुतिर्मारुतो यथा।जगाम हरिशार्दूलो दिशः शब्देन पूरयन् ।। ६.७४.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: javena mahatā yukto mārutirmāruto yathā।jagāma hariśārdūlo diśaḥ śabdena pūrayan ।। 6.74.55 ।।

translations.english: Going at wind speed, the great monkey Maruthi, remembering Jambavantha's words, reached and sighted the Himalayas.

verses.sloka: स्मरन् जाम्बवतो वाक्यं मारुतिर्वातरंहसा।ददर्श सहसा चापि हिमवन्तं महाकपिः ।। ६.७४.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: smaran jāmbavato vākyaṁ mārutirvātaraṁhasā।dadarśa sahasā cāpi himavantaṁ mahākapiḥ ।। 6.74.56 ।।

translations.english: He reached the foremost of mountains, which was adorned with different kinds of springs, many caves and cascades and graced with trees. The peaks were like masses of white autumn clouds graced with splendour and beautiful to look at.

verses.sloka: नानाप्रस्रवणोपेतं बहुकन्दरनिर्झरम्।श्वेताभ्रचयसङ्काशैः शिखरैश्चारुदर्शनैः।शोभितं विविधैर्वृक्षैरगमत् पर्वतोत्तमम् ।। ६.७४.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: nānāprasravaṇopetaṁ bahukandaranirjharam।śvetābhracayasaṅkāśaiḥ śikharaiścārudarśanaiḥ।śobhitaṁ vividhairvṛkṣairagamat parvatottamam ।। 6.74.57 ।।

translations.english: Reaching there he saw the tall and terrifying peaks of the Lord of mountains frequented by Devatas and sages, meritorious hermitages.

verses.sloka: स तं समासाद्य महानगेन्द्रमतिप्रवृद्धोत्तमघोरशृङ्गम्।ददर्श पुण्यानि महाश्रमाणि सुरर्षिसङ्घोत्तमसेवितानि ।। ६.७४.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ samāsādya mahānagendramatipravṛddhottamaghoraśṛṅgam।dadarśa puṇyāni mahāśramāṇi surarṣisaṅghottamasevitāni ।। 6.74.58 ।।

translations.english: He saw the seat of Brahma, the abode of Rajathanabha, the abode of Indra, the location from which Rudra discharged an arrow (at Tripura), the abode of Lord Hayagriva, and glowing abode of the deity presiding over Brahmastra and Vyvasvatah's attendants.

verses.sloka: स ब्रह्मकोशं रजतालयं च शक्रालयं रुद्रशरप्रमोक्षम्।हयाननं ब्रह्मशिरश्च दीप्तं ददर्श वैवस्वतकिङ्करांश्च ।। ६.७४.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa brahmakośaṁ rajatālayaṁ ca śakrālayaṁ rudraśarapramokṣam।hayānanaṁ brahmaśiraśca dīptaṁ dadarśa vaivasvatakiṅkarāṁśca ।। 6.74.59 ।।

translations.english: He saw Vajralayam (where Brahma gave Indra the thunderbolt), the abode of Kubera shining like the Sun, the spot where the Sun was bound, Brahma's abode and the abode of the bow of Lord Siva, and the earth navel.

verses.sloka: वज्रालयं वैश्रवणालयं च सूर्यप्रभं सूर्यनिबन्धनं च।ब्रह्मासनं शङ्करकार्मुकं च ददर्श नाभिं च वसुन्धरायाः ।। ६.७४.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: vajrālayaṁ vaiśravaṇālayaṁ ca sūryaprabhaṁ sūryanibandhanaṁ ca।brahmāsanaṁ śaṅkarakārmukaṁ ca dadarśa nābhiṁ ca vasundharāyāḥ ।। 6.74.60 ।।

translations.english: He saw Kailas, the rocks of Himalayas, that way on the Rshaba the foremost Lord Siva, the golden mountain, and the great mountain on which grew, glowing medicinal herbs.

verses.sloka: कैलासमग्र्यं हिमवच्छिलां च तथर्षभं काञ्चनशैलमग्र्यम्।सन्दीप्तसर्वौषधिसम्प्रदीप्तं ददर्श सर्वौषधिपर्वतेन्द्रम् ।। ६.७४.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: kailāsamagryaṁ himavacchilāṁ ca tatharṣabhaṁ kāñcanaśailamagryam।sandīptasarvauṣadhisampradīptaṁ dadarśa sarvauṣadhiparvatendram ।। 6.74.61 ।।

translations.english: Observing the herbs blazing like fire, he was astonished at the herbs on the mountain and went round thinking of the names of herbs (asked by Jambavan).

verses.sloka: स तं समीक्ष्यानलरश्मिदीप्तं विसिष्मिये वासवदूतसूनुः।आवृत्य तं चौषधिपर्वतेन्द्रं तत्रौषधीनां विचयञ्चकार ।। ६.७४.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ samīkṣyānalaraśmidīptaṁ visiṣmiye vāsavadūtasūnuḥ।āvṛtya taṁ cauṣadhiparvatendraṁ tatrauṣadhīnāṁ vicayañcakāra ।। 6.74.62 ।।

translations.english: The great monkey, son of the wind god, having traversed a thousand yojanas began to range the wonderful herbs and went about searching.

verses.sloka: स योजनसहस्राणि समतीत्य महाकपिः।दिव्यौषधिधरं शैलं व्यचरन्मारुतात्मजः ।। ६.७४.६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa yojanasahasrāṇi samatītya mahākapiḥ।divyauṣadhidharaṁ śailaṁ vyacaranmārutātmajaḥ ।। 6.74.63 ।।

translations.english: Perceiving a seeker coming for them, the herbs all over the wonderful mountain disappeared.

verses.sloka: महौषध्यस्ततः सर्वास्तस्मिन् पर्वतसत्तमे।विज्ञायार्थिनमायान्तं ततो जग्मुरदर्शनम् ।। ६.७४.६४ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahauṣadhyastataḥ sarvāstasmin parvatasattame।vijñāyārthinamāyāntaṁ tato jagmuradarśanam ।। 6.74.64 ।।

translations.english: The great soul Hanuman was not able to see, those herbs, became angry and his eyes were burning like fire in anger. He jumped up and roared and said to the lordly mountain.

verses.sloka: स ता महात्मा हनुमानपश्यन् चुकोप कोपाच्च भृशं ननाद।अमृष्यमाणो ऽग्निनिकाशचक्षुर्महीधरेन्द्रं तमुवाच वाक्यम् ।। ६.७४.६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tā mahātmā hanumānapaśyan cukopa kopācca bhṛśaṁ nanāda।amṛṣyamāṇo 'gninikāśacakṣurmahīdharendraṁ tamuvāca vākyam ।। 6.74.65 ।।

translations.english: "O King of mountains! You are not showing compassion to Raghava. Is it your determination to be like this? Overcome by my shoulder strength I shall crush you now. You may see."

verses.sloka: किमेतदेवं सुविनिश्चितं ते यद्राघवे नासि कृतानुकम्पः।पश्याद्य मद्बाहुबलाभिभूतो विकीर्णमात्मानमथो नगेन्द्र ।। ६.७४.६६ ।।
verses.transliteration: kimetadevaṁ suviniścitaṁ te yadrāghave nāsi kṛtānukampaḥ।paśyādya madbāhubalābhibhūto vikīrṇamātmānamatho nagendra ।। 6.74.66 ।।

translations.english: Seizing hold of the peaks vehemently, its trees, elephants, gold mines withthousands of minerals he crushed the projections and set fire and burnt and uprooted swiftly.

verses.sloka: स तस्य शृङ्गं सनगं सनागं सकाञ्चनं धातुसहस्रजुष्टम्।विकीर्णकूटज्वलिताग्रसानुं प्रगृह्य वेगात् सहसोन्ममाथ ।। ६.७४.६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya śṛṅgaṁ sanagaṁ sanāgaṁ sakāñcanaṁ dhātusahasrajuṣṭam।vikīrṇakūṭajvalitāgrasānuṁ pragṛhya vegāt sahasonmamātha ।। 6.74.67 ।।

translations.english: Striking terror among Devatas and demons and leaders inhabiting the world, uprooting the mountain he hurried at Garuda's speed into the sky praised by aerial creatures.

verses.sloka: स तं समुत्पाट्य खमुत्पपात वित्रास्य लोकान् ससुरासुरेन्द्रान्।संस्तूयमानः खचरैरनेकैर्जगाम वैगाद् गरुडोग्रवेगः ।। ६.७४.६८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ samutpāṭya khamutpapāta vitrāsya lokān sasurāsurendrān।saṁstūyamānaḥ khacarairanekairjagāma vaigād garuḍogravegaḥ ।। 6.74.68 ।।

translations.english: Resembling the Sun closely, radiant like the Sun he was taking the top of the mountain, betaking himself in the vicinity of the Sun he was like another Sun.

verses.sloka: स भास्कराध्वानमनुप्रपन्नस्तं भास्कराभं शिखरं प्रगृह्य।बभौ तदा भास्करसन्निकाशो रवेः समीपे प्रतिभास्कराभः ।। ६.७४.६९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa bhāskarādhvānamanuprapannastaṁ bhāskarābhaṁ śikharaṁ pragṛhya।babhau tadā bhāskarasannikāśo raveḥ samīpe pratibhāskarābhaḥ ।। 6.74.69 ।।

translations.english: He, the son of the wind god sitting upon the crag, was delightful like Vishnu with a flaming wheel shining.

verses.sloka: स तेन शैलेन भृशं रराज शैलोपमो गन्धवहात्मजस्तु।सहस्रधारेण सपावकेन चक्रेण खे विष्णुरिवार्पितेन ।। ६.७४.७० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tena śailena bhṛśaṁ rarāja śailopamo gandhavahātmajastu।sahasradhāreṇa sapāvakena cakreṇa khe viṣṇurivārpitena ।। 6.74.70 ।।

translations.english: Observing him high the Vanaras became joyful, and he also saw them. Hearing their loud noise becoming aware of the Rakshasas of Lanka also roared in terrible fear.

verses.sloka: तं वानराः प्रेक्ष्य विनेदुरुच्चैः स तानपि प्रेक्ष्य मुदा ननाद।तेषां समुद्घुष्टरवं निशम्य लङ्कालया भीमतरं विनेदुः ।। ६.७४.७१ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ vānarāḥ prekṣya vineduruccaiḥ sa tānapi prekṣya mudā nanāda।teṣāṁ samudghuṣṭaravaṁ niśamya laṅkālayā bhīmataraṁ vineduḥ ।। 6.74.71 ।।

translations.english: The great Hanuman along with the mountain descended in the midst of the Vanara army, and greeted the army head bent down and embraced Vibheeshana standing there.

verses.sloka: ततो महात्मा निपपात तस्मिन् शैलोत्तमे वानरसैन्यमध्ये।हर्युत्तमेभ्यः शिरसा ऽभिवाद्य विभीषणं तत्र स सस्वजे च ।। ६.७४.७२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato mahātmā nipapāta tasmin śailottame vānarasainyamadhye।haryuttamebhyaḥ śirasā 'bhivādya vibhīṣaṇaṁ tatra sa sasvaje ca ।। 6.74.72 ।।

translations.english: The two sons of the ruler of men inhaling the fragrance of the herbs became free from wounds. Other Vanara heroes also got restored.

verses.sloka: तावप्युभौ मानुषराजपुत्रौ तं गन्धमाघ्राय महौषधीनाम्।बभूवतुस्तत्र तदा विशल्यावुत्तस्थुरन्ये च हरिप्रवीराः ।। ६.७४.७३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāvapyubhau mānuṣarājaputrau taṁ gandhamāghrāya mahauṣadhīnām।babhūvatustatra tadā viśalyāvuttasthuranye ca haripravīrāḥ ।। 6.74.73 ।।

translations.english: All those Vanara warriors killed were restored with life instantly by the fragrance. Those who were asleep also got up when they became fully awake.

verses.sloka: सर्वे विशल्या विरुजः क्षणेन हरिप्रवीरा निहताश्च ये स्युः।गन्धेन तासां प्रवरौषधीनां सुप्ता निशान्तेष्विव सम्प्रबुद्धाः ।। ६.७४.७४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarve viśalyā virujaḥ kṣaṇena haripravīrā nihatāśca ye syuḥ।gandhena tāsāṁ pravarauṣadhīnāṁ suptā niśānteṣviva samprabuddhāḥ ।। 6.74.74 ।।

translations.english: From the beginning of the war in Lanka till the end without exception, all the Rakshasas were killed in war by the Vanara leaders then and there were thrown into the ocean by Ravana's instruction, not to have means of proof.

verses.sloka: यदाप्रभृति लङ्कायां युद्ध्यन्ते कपिराक्षसाः।तदाप्रभृति मानार्थमाज्ञया रावणस्य च ।। ६.७४.७५ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadāprabhṛti laṅkāyāṁ yuddhyante kapirākṣasāḥ।tadāprabhṛti mānārthamājñayā rāvaṇasya ca ।। 6.74.75 ।।

translations.english: From the beginning of the war in Lanka till the end without exception, all the Rakshasas were killed in war by the Vanara leaders then and there were thrown into the ocean by Ravana's instruction, not to have means of proof.

verses.sloka: ये हन्यन्ते रणे तत्र राक्षसाः कपिकुञ्जरैः।हता हतास्तु क्षिप्यन्ते सर्व एव तु सागरे ।। ६.७४.७६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ye hanyante raṇe tatra rākṣasāḥ kapikuñjaraiḥ।hatā hatāstu kṣipyante sarva eva tu sāgare ।। 6.74.76 ।।

translations.english: Then that monkey of towering might, the son of the bearer of scents, carried the mountain of healing herbs swiftly back to Himavat itself, and came again to Rama.

verses.sloka: ततो हरिर्गन्धवहात्मजस्तु तमोषधीशैलमुदग्रवीर्यः।निनाय वेगाद्धिमवन्तमेव पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम ।। ६.७४.७७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato harirgandhavahātmajastu tamoṣadhīśailamudagravīryaḥ।nināya vegāddhimavantameva punaśca rāmeṇa samājagāma ।। 6.74.77 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुस्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। ७४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe catussaptatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 74 ।।
